supersedes.why: v1 kept unchanged (frozen); v2 adds the reserved window with its hard end and the P-L2-1 separation check ; the code refuses v1 for a run (no hard end, no separation check)

purpose: Public-data capture pilot of OKX Europe X-Perps order-book depth (L2) and public trades, to study LATER the feasibility of take-profit / stop-loss rules adapted to the order book. Development / exploration only, never a confirmation. Nothing is scheduled; one run, started by hand.

authorization.text: a public-data capture pilot, start no earlier than 2026-11-02 and respecting the LP programme prerequisites; two X-Perps contracts, BTC and ETH, selected by authorized metadata; max 24 h; at most 5 GiB written and at least 10 GiB kept free; clean stop as soon as a limit is hit; no automatic extension or restart.
authorization.today: prepare the tool and its exact command only; schedule nothing (no cron, no systemd unit, no scheduled task). No orders, no flags, no merge.
authorization.reserved_window: owner mission of 2026-10-22 (decision P-L2-1, D14): reserve a short development exploration window for the pilot, preferred slot 2026-11-02T00:00Z -> 2026-11-03T00:00Z (a later manual start shortens it, never shifts the end) ; keep BTC/ETH X-Perps, 24 h max, 5 GiB max written, >= 10 GiB free, no restart or extension ; refuse before the start, after the end, and while the separation is not recorded

window.duration_rule: duration = min(limits.max_duration_s, hard_end_utc - start) ; a later manual start shortens the run, never shifts its end ; refused before start_not_before_utc and at or after hard_end_utc ; one run, no restart, no extension (stop reason hard_end when the hard end binds)
window.decision: P-L2-1 (D14, 2026-10-22): the reserved development exploration window of the L2 capture pilot

g5_gate2_block.decision: P-L2-1 (LP-OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-21.md D14 ; owner mission of 2026-10-22): reserve a short development exploration window for the L2 capture pilot, preferred slot 2026-11-02T00:00Z -> 2026-11-03T00:00Z (a later manual start shortens it, never shifts the end), separated from every decisive use of the LP programme by the observations used, not by storage folders
g5_gate2_block.rule: no observation timestamped in excluded_interval_utc (prints, books, bbo, mark, index, funding messages, liquidations, open interest, message counts) enters a decisive computation of the LP programme, nor its footprints, look-backs, warm-ups, rodage day, calibration, quality rules or instrument selection ; data captured in that interval, by the pilot or by any LP collector, are development data only

applies_to.g5_gate1: absent: historical window 2026-04-28 .. 2026-10-14 (exclusive), fetched and read under g5_fetch.END_EXCLUSIVE
applies_to.g5_gate2: T0 >= g5_gate2_t0_min_utc = first 00:00 UTC >= separation_floor_utc + max_lookback_min (480-minute classifier look-back before t_arm, 60-minute margin of g5_index_fetch ; every footprint starts at or after T0) ; capture rows before separation_floor_utc dropped and counted before any computation (g5_eval.load_capture_series), a residual row refused ; g5_index_fetch refuses a start before separation_floor_utc
applies_to.g2: T0 = first 00:00 UTC >= max(2026-11-02 ; separation_floor_utc ; end of P3 ; freeze + 24 h) ; rodage day T0 ; research_lp simulate and events refuse the day files of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03 (day granularity, stricter than the floor) unless --separation-waiver-reason TEXT (development only, recorded in the guard record)
applies_to.g4_gate2: the look-back history (2 016 five-minute bins, at least 288) and the 24-hour sigma and notional hold no bin before separation_floor_utc: research_lp events refuses the day files of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03 ; bins before the first readable day are absent, never imputed
applies_to.p3: research_lp count refuses a --not-before before separation_floor_utc: P3 never runs during the pilot, its counts, coverage table and selection file hold no minute of excluded_interval_utc
applies_to.pilot: l2-pilot-spec/2: start >= reserved_interval_utc[0], hard end reserved_interval_utc[1] whatever the start, duration = min(24 h, hard end - start) ; capture and replay-check refused unless this block is found, sha256 of its canonical JSON equal, in the G5 Gate 2 spec given

g5_gate2_block.reading: pilot content (prices, books, trades) opened only once this separation is recorded (P-L2-1 in LP-OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-21.md and in REGISTRY.md, this block in the G5 Gate 2 spec) ; before that, quality and volume summaries only ; a protocol frozen after the pilot content is opened declares that exposure among its prior exposures (development data, never a threshold, a window or a universe choice) ; the pilot's volume measures never decide the P3 / G2 collector ceiling (G2 3.4: P3 facts only)

separation.rule: capture, plan and replay-check refuse unless --separation-spec names a G5 Gate 2 spec (spec_id g5_gate2_spec_id, spec_version >= g5_gate2_min_version, requires holding g5_gate2_requires) whose pilot_separation block hashes (sha256 of its canonical JSON: sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8) to g5_gate2_block_sha256 (= g5_gate2_block, copied here) and whose reserved interval is this window, and unless --separation-ref starts with decision_id ; nothing is read from that spec but these fields

channels.fallback_rule: books5 is always subscribed next to books (declared fallback and cross-check). If books is refused for an instrument (error event), the run continues with books5 + trades for it, the refusal is written in the manifest (depth_status = books5_only) and the dataset is labelled 5-level only for that instrument. Never an automatic switch to another channel, host or login.

excluded.bbo-tbt: 1 level only; not needed for L2 (speed not required by the authorization)
excluded.books-rpi: consolidated with RPI depth; not part of the authorization
excluded.trades-all: URL path /ws/v5/business (a second connection, no cross-connection ordering with books); trades on /ws/v5/public keeps the documented sequential publication of book and aggregated trades

storage.format: gzip JSONL, one record per line, segments seg-NNNNNN.jsonl.gz
storage.record_frame: {rx, recv_ns, mono_ns, conn, k: frame, h: header (ids, seq, counts; no price), raw: frame text exactly as received}
storage.record_meta: {rx, recv_ns, mono_ns, conn, k: meta, event, ...}
storage.availability_order: rx (reception order of the process = write order)

quality_criteria.verdict_rule: PASS if every criterion holds on both instruments with books; PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS if the run stopped on a limit or a signal before 24 h, or only books5 was available, while the criteria hold on what was captured; FAIL otherwise (or if a segment hash does not verify)

protection.use: development / exploration of book-adapted TP/SL feasibility only
protection.content_sealed: Before the separation is recorded (P-L2-1 in LP-OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-21.md D14 and in REGISTRY.md, the pilot_separation block in the G5 Gate 2 spec, checked by sha256), only quality and volume summaries (header fields, no price) are allowed. Once recorded, the content (prices, books, trades) may be opened for development only (replay-check needs --separation-spec and --unsealed-ref): never a confirmation, never a threshold, window, universe or collector ceiling of a decisive test ; a protocol frozen after the opening declares that exposure among its prior exposures.
